{{Quote|Looks like the engines are set to destroy themselves.|The droid to General Grievous|<ref name="Destroy" />}}
A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], and served under the command of [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]].<ref name="Destroy" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> after the ''Malevolence'' suffered a defeat at the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]], the Separatist forces captured [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and brought her aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in order to force the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ships to stop their attack. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and a fellow one then escorted [[General/Legends|General]] Grievous to the senator's [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|starship]], which exploded after it was rigged. The two droids were destroyed in the explosion, but Grievous escaped in time.<ref name="Destroy" />
